list: Competition kit list frozen 2026-11-18; not independently verified in-game

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Complete the other 54 single-player trophies. Start with the story, work through the post-story completion checklist, then finish any remaining stranger strands and miscellaneous trophies in free roam. PowerPyx reports that multiplayer and DLC are unnecessary.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play through Gone Fishing at the start of Chapter 1. PowerPyx identifies this as an automatic story unlock, with no additional challenge to complete. Keep a chapter save if you want a return point because the guide reports no mission replay.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Continue beyond Chapter 1 into Chapter 2 and finish What’s in the Bag?. PowerPyx places the automatic chapter trophy at that mission rather than at the preceding chapter’s final screen. A manual chapter save provides a return point.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: After finishing Chapter 2, proceed into Chapter 3 and complete Welcome to Vice City. PowerPyx says the milestone unlocks automatically there. The guide recommends keeping chapter saves because missions cannot be replayed.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Progress through Chapter 3, then complete both Ocean Beach and Another Life at the start of Chapter 4. PowerPyx associates the automatic chapter unlock with those two missions. Keep a chapter save if you want a way back.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Continue the main story through Starting From Zero. PowerPyx assigns the Chapter 4 milestone to that mission, but its account also places another mission in Chapter 5. The chapter sequence is Unconfirmed because the same roadmap conflicts with itself.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Continue the main story to its ending. PowerPyx calls Starting From Zero the final mission in Chapter 4, while separately listing Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. The exact ending sequence is Unconfirmed, so avoid relying on that placement for planning.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Play Breakfast Run during Chapter 2. PowerPyx describes the unlock as automatic during the main story, with no separate side objective. Keep a chapter save if you want to revisit the sequence, since mission replay is unavailable according to the roadmap.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Continue the Chapter 3 main story through The Cartel Heist. PowerPyx says this trophy is automatic during that mission. It lists no special medal or extra condition, and recommends chapter saves because there is no mission replay.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete Child’s Play in Chapter 4 as part of the main story. PowerPyx treats this as an automatic unlock and gives no separate challenge for it. Chapter saves are useful if you want to return to story content later.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. The roadmap describes the trophy as story-related and automatic, without an extra objective. Consider preserving a chapter save because the guide says missions cannot be replayed.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Play through VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. PowerPyx reports an automatic story unlock rather than a separate airport activity. Save at chapter boundaries if you want a return point, as the roadmap lists no mission replay.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Continue to Operation Savage Glory, which PowerPyx labels a Chapter 5 main mission, and complete it for the automatic trophy. Its separate final-mission chapter placement conflicts, so the overall ordering is Unconfirmed.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: After the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and finish the listed requirements. Earlier progress counts. PowerPyx recommends scanning new vehicles and studying animals during the story, then completing outstanding activities in free roam. The checklist requires partial completion of several categories rather than every collectible.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts in any mix of jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps. PowerPyx recommends bridge flights for speed. Check regional totals under Progress > Activities > Stunts; the separate 100% checklist needs 300, so continuing beyond the trophy saves cleanup.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try the activity types listed in the roadmap, including fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball and video games, plus a race win and a stunt. Review Progress > Activities as you go. PowerPyx does not specify a mandatory order.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Complete the shooting-range challenges and earn gold in each one. PowerPyx lists 12 ranges and 42 gold medals in its linked guide, but gives no individual challenge walkthrough in the roadmap. Specific tactics and locations are Unconfirmed in the material available here.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each location. PowerPyx links a separate guide listing 14 locations and 42 races, but the roadmap does not spell out individual course routes. Specific course tips are Unconfirmed in the material available here.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races, rather than repeating one race. PowerPyx points to a separate list of 40 unique race locations. The provided roadmap does not establish which routes are easiest, so a preferred route is Unconfirmed.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, wait for Cal’s text and look for the purple fishing marker. Follow his fishing questline until the challenge against him appears, then beat him. PowerPyx does not provide a fixed wait time for the message.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Use the controllers at a home television from Chapter 1 to play Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III or Time Jackers Rewind, or find Bang For Your Buck at an arcade machine. Finish every level of one game. PowerPyx says optional challenges are unnecessary and the home games can be temporarily unavailable during story sections.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play as Lucia during Chapter 3 and wait for Andy’s call and address in Belville. Follow the five-part questline from Climbing the Cellerichain through Puff Puff Pass at the warehouse. PowerPyx says the quests remain available after the story.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: After Island Dreams in Chapter 1, wait for Kenton’s call and green KR marker at Key Lento. Recover treasure from the seven shipwrecks he marks and bring it back, using the metal detector on the seabed. He may temporarily disappear after Chapter 1 but PowerPyx says he returns later and the line remains available after the story.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, visit Billy’s marker at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Finish his five quests, ending with Hometown Heroes. PowerPyx says his questline remains available after the story, so a temporary delay does not require restarting.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight qualifying stranger mission strands. PowerPyx identifies Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete as examples, but says several other optional characters do not count. Track the trophy total and finish further qualifying strands in free roam. The complete list of qualifying strangers remains Unconfirmed.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: After Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ GS in Chapter 3, use the Key Cloner and check Map > Robberies > Randy’s Wish List. Deliver his requested sports cars to the green RK garage in western Vice City. PowerPyx says marked cars or matching cars found on the street count and that better condition pays more.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: As Jason, progress beyond Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3 and visit the purple Synthetic Labs markers in Vice City. Destroy enough labs during Take Out Kitty Litter to receive Spin On This, then complete that follow-up. PowerPyx says Lucia cannot start this line and it remains available after the story.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Potentially missable: after Down to Earth in Chapter 1, look for Lucia in the kitchen at Jason’s house in the morning, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. The timing may vary. That session becomes unavailable after Chapter 1, and whether it is required for the trophy is Unconfirmed. The meditation guide lists 18 sessions across 10 locations and says to track them under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. After Coffee Break, use both characters at eligible spots; the final mountain meditation follows the others.
trophies.missableStatus: Potentially missable

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: As Jason, wait for Bret’s message after Coffee Break in Chapter 2 and meet him in Lummox County for Veteran Hunted. Visit the purple hunting markers and return requested animals to Bret. PowerPyx says the questline remains available after the story, but which unique animal triggers this specific trophy is Unconfirmed.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collect all cards in any three distinct sets. The specialist guide lists cards in indoor locations and outdoor containers such as yellow phone boxes and toolboxes. Duplicates do not add set progress, while colour variants count separately. Selling cards at pawn shops does not remove collection progress, according to the guide.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK to scan 100 different eligible environmental locations. PowerPyx identifies landmarks, curiosities and sculptures among the scan types and says the choice of locations is flexible. Scan newly encountered points while exploring instead of trying to repeat one location.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 available challenges. Check Progress > Challenges for the completed indicator and choose easier outstanding tasks after other trophy work. The 100% checklist needs 70 challenges, so continuing to that target also covers this trophy.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break allows both characters to roam together, call your partner and build a four-star wanted level. Escape the red heat area together. PowerPyx suggests the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County to avoid police and helicopter pursuit.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break, bring your partner and rob three marked targets while police are actively pursuing you. PowerPyx suggests the northern Vice City jewellery stores after Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs. Take several items at each stop and escape the heat area; if the first robbery ended before police arrived, try another store.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK to scan unfamiliar passing cars, boats and aircraft until 100 vehicles are discovered. PowerPyx says scanning is sufficient without driving each vehicle. Review Progress > Vehicles for category totals; the separate completion checklist calls for 200 base models.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: While aiming a firearm, activate Combat Focus with L3 and R3 and defeat five enemies before the same activation ends. PowerPyx suggests lining up enemies at a gang operation, boosting focus first and using adrenaline to extend the window. It reports that police, soldiers and civilians may not count.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA, enter a large passenger plane connected to a boarding bridge, such as the one at E3/E4. Go upstairs to the cockpit, taxi out, take off and fly roughly one kilometre away. PowerPyx says aircraft parked on the airfield without a bridge do not satisfy this unlock.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Go to Mile Zero Air Station on the southwestern island in Mariana County. Enter a tank in the southern part of the base and fire on enemies until the trophy appears. PowerPyx mentions entering through the gate or using the nearby southeast stunt jump.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Complete Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to obtain the Snap Gun. Enter a jewellery store through its back door without triggering the alarm, find the safe code and loot the safe. Disable the alarm and destroy security footage before leaving; PowerPyx says the trophy can appear shortly afterward.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 optional mission That’s Where The Money Is to unlock large vault jobs. Follow a security van to a bank, enter when the guard opens the vault, take the cash with your partner and escape. Repeat at five large vaults. The bank guide lists eight large jobs, all needed for the completion checklist.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: During the Chapter 4 optional mission That’s Where The Money Is, follow the armoured truck to the bank, take the cash after the guard opens the vault and leave the red heat area. PowerPyx says the introductory large-vault job counts. It also describes an earlier truck robbery using a sticky bomb on its rear door.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Remove the black fog from the whole map. PowerPyx recommends using a plane and flying over areas that are still obscured, then checking the map for remaining patches. Its roadmap does not specify a required flight path.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each gang. Operations appear as yellow map markers, and Progress > Gangs shows each gang’s robbery count. The specialist guide lists 39 operations and says to collect key valuables. The 100% checklist requires all operations, beyond the one-per-gang trophy.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Visit Ocean View Rooftop Bar at Ocean Beach, buy an Apple Martini and drink it next to the bar. PowerPyx identifies this specific drink and location for the unlock. The roadmap does not list another prerequisite.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: First obtain the Key Cloner during Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ GS in Chapter 3. At the showroom in southern Vice City, unlock the blue Banshee and drive it through the window, then continue down the street. PowerPyx says the unlock can be delayed and requires that particular car.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: At Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, collect the office watch, the unique shotgun and the safe contents, then escape police. Bring sticky bombs for the safe. PowerPyx says the valuables can be collected across separate visits after the operation respawns, so missing one on the first attempt is recoverable.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break unlocks switching between Jason and Lucia, raise both characters’ Strength to maximum. Use fitness clubs or work out at home, and check each character’s Strength in the character screen. PowerPyx suggests training together so the partner also exercises.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions affecting the criminal profile. Enable criminal-profile HUD notifications to see which actions count, and check the trophy tracker for progress. Stealthy robberies, incapacitations and violence can contribute. PowerPyx warns that the Irredeemable profile is permanent and affects police behaviour.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The unlock condition is Unconfirmed. PowerPyx describes a possible connection to the prologue payday-loan store as speculation, without a verified sequence. Keep a save if investigating and do not treat that theory as a confirmed requirement.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Go alone at night after 2 a.m. to the road northwest of Starlet Motel in Kelly County. PowerPyx says a blinking car may appear intermittently. Follow the nearby path, approach the light, talk to the woman and help her return to the car. If the car does not appear, leave and revisit.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: PowerPyx describes kicking ten pedestrians within 60 seconds while riding a motorcycle or bicycle, suggesting a busy Vice City or Ocean Beach area. Earlier guide text treated the trigger as unknown, so the exact condition is Unconfirmed until independently checked.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Finish Credit Check in Chapter 3 to obtain the Dye Pack Jammer. Rob banks or payday-loan stores and take marked bills to a fence until the cumulative laundered amount reaches $250,000. PowerPyx says this need not be delivered at once and identifies Yasmani as a high-paying contact.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 across shops. PowerPyx suggests higher-cost purchases such as weapons, vehicle modifications and tattoos to build the total. It gives no requirement to spend the entire amount at one shop.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: After Daily Driver in Chapter 2 installs the Vice City Real Estate phone app, buy the eight purchasable garages through it. PowerPyx lists a combined price of $160,000 and says the four story-related garages are not part of the purchase requirement.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — Existing notes associate this with the Chapter 2 Moses mission, the Scooter Bros app and registering ten stolen vehicles at his Port Gellhorn garage. The supplied PowerPyx roadmap extract does not explain this trophy, so the prerequisites and registration steps have not been verified against it.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies
